description: This file defines the access control handler class for comment entities in Drupal, managing permissions for viewing, editing, creating, and field-level access control for comments.

classes.name: CommentAccessControlHandler
classes.description: Defines access control logic for comment entities, including permissions for viewing, editing, creating, and field-level access control.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for a given operation on a comment entity, considering user permissions, comment status, and ownership.

methods.name: checkCreateAccess
methods.description: Determines if a user has permission to create a comment.

methods.name: checkFieldAccess
methods.description: Checks field-level access permissions for editing or viewing comment fields, considering user permissions, comment status, and field-specific rules.
